newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group started.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it had initiated coverage of Apollo Group Inc with a long-term outperform rating. In the medium term, EVEREN rates the stock a market performer.

-- Apollo Group, a for-profit, degree-granting higher education company, is well situated to benefit from higher college participation rates and an increasing number of adults attending school, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said it has set a an 18-month price target of $35 a share for Apollo.
-- Shares of Apollo traded off 1/4 at 27-1/4.
